events.subtitle: Choose what the customer is told, and on which channel

whatsapp.explainer: WhatsApp messages are sent by Ebda Chat, not from here, so this column has no on/off switch. Order confirmations are controlled in the bot settings in Ebda Chat; shipping updates are always on. The delivery log lives in Ebda Chat for now.

push.subtitle: Notifications that appear on the customer's phone or browser
push.platformNote: No setup needed from you. Just turn it on and we handle the rest.
